subject: QBR prep: CloudWorks stakeholder bridge & renewal triage
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: CloudWorks stakeholder bridge & renewal triage

Team —

Starting the thread for CloudWorks QBR prep. Renewal hits next month (deal HW-4821). Current health signals: throughput spikes in late May, two incidents with elevated tail latency, and a growing concern from procurement around unit economics (they hit a token cap and saw an unexpected bill).

Immediate asks:
- Chloe: own the technical health packet & deep-dive (metrics, incidents, mitigation log). See attachment cloudworks-healthpack.pdf.
- Aditya: run numbers on proposed Dedicated pricing scenarios + suggested one-time credit if we need to keep them on hosted during the QBR cycle.
- Vivek: we may need exec presence for the bridge — are you able to join if we escalate?

Goal: align internal owners, confirm bridge time with customer this week, and prepare an executive-ready briefing (one-pager + MAP). I've attached a draft mutual_action_plan.xlsx.

Timing: please ack ownership and upload your artifacts to the Confluence page by EOD Monday (14 Jun).

Priya
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: CloudWorks stakeholder bridge & renewal triage

Priya —

Ack. I'll take the technical packet. Summary so far (will populate the Confluence doc):
- Incident timeline + RCA for the two tail-latency events (root cause: bursty batched workloads + suboptimal batching window).
- Current perf: 99th percentile latency elevated ~320ms on long prompts; average token cost delta +12% vs baseline.
- Ops mitigation: prefix cache tweak and temp cap on batch size; mitigation reduced error rate by ~70% in last 48h.

Attaching tse-ops-notes.txt with the immediate mitigation steps. I'll prepare a 10-slide exec summary focused on impact to their SLAs and suggested short-term config changes to reduce cost.

—Chloe
Senior Solutions Engineer

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Scheduling: Exec bridge & QBR prep (CloudWorks)

Emma —

Thanks for taking the time to speak with us about your upcoming QBR and renewal. We want to ensure we surface the technical story and commercial options clearly. Proposed agenda for an executive bridge:
1) Quick health snapshot (10m) — root cause + mitigations (Chloe)
2) Pricing & options (10m) — Dedicated vs Hosted, short-term credit options (Aditya)
3) Business impact & next steps (10m) — exec alignment, MAP sign-off

Are you available Thursday (17 Jun) 11:00am PT for a 30-minute bridge? I'll loop in our SVP if we need exec coverage.

I've attached the health pack and a draft mutual action plan for your review.

Priya

Attachments: cloudworks-healthpack.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Emma Lowe <emma@cloudworks.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Haines <tom@cloudworks.com>, CloudWorks Procurement <procure@cloudworks.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:36:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Exec bridge & QBR prep (CloudWorks)

Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the docs. The team is available on Thu 17 Jun 11:00am PT. Two items to call out ahead of the bridge:
1) Cost: we hit an unexpected overage in May when a new internal app sent higher-volume prompts. Before we talk SLAs, procurement wants clearer caps and a committed unit price for the renewal.
2) Data residency question: legal asked about retention windows for K/V cache and logs — can someone confirm our default retention and whether we can shorten it for them?

I copied procurement so we can surface the renewal terms and any credit request.

Emma
Customer Success Manager, CloudWorks

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Exec bridge & QBR prep (CloudWorks)

Team —

I'm escalating this to exec attention given procurement is looped and they flagged billing/overage concerns. Priorities for the bridge:
- Produce a 1-page executive brief that states the problem, commercial options (including a limited credit), and the recommended commitment path (Dedicated PO with X% discount + 90-day price lock).
- Confirm retention defaults and an option to shorten for compliance; legal should sign off but we need clear language for the bridge.
- I will join the bridge if Priya confirms the one-pager is ready 24 hours beforehand.

Aditya: please prepare a clear numerical comparison (TCO over 12 months hosted vs Dedicated) and one proposal with a temporary credit (amount and justification). Chloe: prioritize the SLA/regression language that reduces renewal friction.

Vivek
SVP, Customer Success

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lowe <emma@cloudworks.com>, Tom Haines <tom@cloudworks.com>, CloudWorks Procurement <procure@cloudworks.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Exec bridge & QBR prep (CloudWorks)

Thank you — quick status update and final asks before the bridge on Thu: 17 Jun is confirmed (calendar invite sent).

Current action owners (deliverables by Wed EOD PT):
- Chloe: exec-friendly health one-pager + incident RCA appendix (slides).
- Aditya: 12-month TCO comparison + proposed credit figure and contract language for a Dedicated pilot.
- Legal ops: finalize short retention language for K/V and audit logs (we expect 30-day and 90-day options).
- Priya: compile one-pager + MAP and circulate to CloudWorks and Vivek 24 hours before the bridge.

Attachments included here are the health pack and the MAP draft. I'll post the final one-pager to Confluence and HubSpot once Aditya & Chloe confirm their sections.

Exec asks for the bridge:
1) Approve a one-time credit up to $18k if needed to keep them on Hosted while we complete migration planning.
2) Approve committing a Dedicated PO discussion (commercial team to lead the follow-up).

I'll follow up with a DM to Vivek on the credit rationale.

Thanks all — Priya
Attachments: cloudworks-healthpack.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx
